title: Every acceptance makes an explicit telemetry decision

facts.note: Adoption alternative A: a telemetry root (tracking plan) exists in the repository. Repository-level predicate, checked directly by the existing validator planner_telemetry_plan. Adoption = A OR B; either alone activates the rule.
Adoption alternative B: any acceptance in the repository declares telemetry. Repository-level predicate, inspectable from acceptance artifacts. Adoption = A OR B; either alone activates the rule.

Once adopted, the rule applies to every acceptance and every tracking-plan item that exists (zero or more of each), including untouched files; no edit/diff gate. Absence of plan items does not suspend the acceptance-decision obligation.

fires: Telemetry is adopted and any acceptance in the repository (new or existing, untouched) has no telemetry block — including when no tracking-plan items exist yet.
An acceptance declares disposition missing or other than required / not-applicable.
An acceptance declares required with an empty list (zero URNs).
An acceptance declares required with a URN that is malformed, non-concrete, or absent from the tracking plan.
An acceptance declares not-applicable with no rationale or a rationale under 20 characters.
A tracking-plan item (including in tracking-plan-only changes, or when no acceptance declares telemetry) references an acceptance that no acceptance declares.
doesNotFire: No telemetry root exists and no acceptance declares telemetry (capability not adopted).
A tracking-plan item serves acceptances beyond those that list it as required (lists need not mirror).
Diagnostic logs or internal spans that no acceptance requires have no dedicated test.

given: Telemetry is adopted: a telemetry root exists, or any acceptance declares telemetry (either alone suffices).
when: You plan or review any acceptance or tracking-plan item.
then: Every acceptance declares disposition `required` listing at least one well-formed concrete telemetry URN that the acceptance demands be observed emitted and that exists as a tracking-plan item under the telemetry root, or disposition `not-applicable` with a rationale of at least 20 characters.
prefer: Shape: `telemetry: {disposition: required, events: [<concrete telemetry:event:… URN from the tracking plan>]}` or `telemetry: {disposition: not-applicable, rationale: <considered reason, ≥20 chars>}`.
List required items by kind (events, metrics, traces, logs).
Treat not-applicable as a considered answer, not the absence of one.
Make every acceptance a tracking-plan item names resolve to a declared acceptance.
avoid: Omitting the telemetry block once adopted — silence is not a disposition.
Malformed, non-concrete or unplanned URNs (the requirement is unplannable).
Token rationales under 20 characters that are not a real answer.
Requiring a test for every debug log or internal span.
Forcing acceptance lists and plan references to mirror each other.
unless: Diagnostic logs and internal spans are not automatically telemetry obligations; the decision is per acceptance.
Inert until adoption: no telemetry root and no acceptance telemetry declaration → nothing emitted (see planner.telemetry.tracking-plan-schema).
why: An explicit per-acceptance decision removes the false choice between testing every debug log and having no observability requirement; both-direction resolution keeps traceability intact.
evidence: Every acceptance has a telemetry block with disposition required or not-applicable.
Each required declaration lists ≥1 URN; each is well-formed, concrete, and resolves to a tracking-plan item under the telemetry root.
Each not-applicable declaration carries a rationale of ≥20 characters.
Every acceptance reference in a tracking-plan item resolves to a declared acceptance.
verifier_detail: Adoption gate: active if a telemetry root exists OR any acceptance declares telemetry; emit nothing only if there is no telemetry root and no acceptance telemetry declaration. Presence of tracking-plan items is not required for acceptance checks.

Decision = disposition plus, for required, concrete item lists (events, metrics, traces, logs); for not-applicable, rationale length ≥ 20 characters. Missing/invalid disposition or empty required list is a finding.
required_item = concrete telemetry URN the acceptance demands be observed emitted; must exist as a tracking-plan item under the telemetry root.

Resolution checked in both directions (acceptance → plan URNs, plan item → acceptance refs); lists are not required to be mirror images because an item may serve acceptances beyond those that first required it.
audit: Source fix_hint verbatim: 'Decide, on every acceptance:' telemetry: {disposition: required, events: [telemetry:event:be:commons:response-invocation-accepted]} or telemetry: {disposition: not-applicable, rationale: No externally useful observable outcome beyond the tested return value.} — the URN and rationale are application-specific examples, generalised in prefer[0].

splitSuggestion.then: Every acceptance reference in a tracking-plan item resolves to a declared acceptance (no dangling traceability links).

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the validator fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: The reverse-direction check (tracking-plan item acceptance references must resolve to declared acceptances) is an independent obligation; kept in prefer/avoid/evidence here, proposed as planner.telemetry.plan-acceptance-refs-resolve.
